heading: Shaping the Website for Örkény Theatre's Rebrand

blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: NUR&MOR invited me to help design Örkény Theatre's new website as part of the theatre's broader rebranding process. The engagement spanned everything from design strategy to high-fidelity wireframes.

Working closely with the theatre's leadership, I shaped the new site's information architecture, layout, and UX patterns to fit their audience's needs. By that point the new brand identity was already finished, so I paid close attention to how its visual language should carry through into the website. NUR&MOR then took the designs through final UI polish.
